pairs.why: B is a calmer three-quarter view with mild perspective and a low, near-horizontal track, like the bus card. A has a wide-angle feel, with the rails converging steeply to the corner and the front boiler swelling toward the camera, much like the rejected close-up wagon views.

The real cards look down on the object so the top face shows (the player's top, the band's rim), and A's higher camera shows the full top of the disc. B drops to a low side view that exposes the underside, which none of the real cards do.
